title: 9-Day Get to Know Tanzania Safari | Big Five & Culture
description: This 9-Day Get to Know Tanzania journey combines Tanzania’s best wildlife, culture, landscapes, and authentic local experiences. Explore Tarangire, Serengeti, and the Ngorongoro Crater for unforgettable Big Five, big cat, birdlife, and seasonal Great Migration experiences.
Enjoy a guided walking experience in Arusha National Park and a special bush dinner in the Serengeti, while discovering Tanzania’s diverse landscapes and wildlife.
Beyond wildlife, connect with a local community, experience a traditional Tanzanian coffee tour, and hike to beautiful Materuni Waterfall with views of Mount Kilimanjaro.

This 9-Day Get to Know Tanzania journey offers a perfect combination of wildlife, adventure, culture, nature, photography, and authentic Tanzanian experiences, giving you the opportunity to experience the country beyond a traditional safari.
highlights: Discover the vibrant city and culture of Arusha.
Visit the Maasai Market, Cultural Heritage Centre, local market, and Arusha Clock Tower.
Enjoy a guided walking experience in Arusha National Park.
Experience excellent bird watching and views of Mount Meru.
Explore Tarangire National Park and its famous elephant herds and baobab trees.
Search for the Big Five, big cats, and diverse birdlife.
Explore the legendary Serengeti National Park.
Search for lions, cheetahs, leopards, hyenas, and jackals.
Experience the Great Wildebeest Migration, depending on the season and location of the herds.
Enjoy two full days of Serengeti exploration focused on wildlife and migration.
Experience a special bush dinner in the Serengeti.
Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable wildlife experience.
Search for black rhinos, elephants, lions, buffalo, hippos, zebras, and wildebeest.
Enjoy a traditional Tanzanian coffee tour.
Visit Materuni Village and hike to Materuni Waterfall.
Enjoy views of Mount Kilimanjaro, weather permitting.
Travel with a professional safari guide throughout the 9-Day Get to Know Tanzania journey.
includes: All transport in a 4x4 safari vehicle
excludes: Optional activities (e.g. hot air balloon safari )

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha – City & Cultural Experience
itinerary.text: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon arrival in Arusha, meet your local representative and begin your Arusha city experience. Visit the Maasai Market, where you can discover traditional crafts, artwork, fabrics, and souvenirs. Continue to the Cultural Heritage Centre to explore Tanzania’s rich artistic and cultural history, followed by a visit to a local Arusha market to experience everyday life and local trading. You will also visit the Arusha Clock Tower, one of the city’s well-known landmarks. In the evening, meet your tour consultant for a safari briefing and introduction to your professional guide, who will accompany you throughout the safari.

itinerary.title: Arusha National Park – Walking, Bird Watching & Game Drive
itinerary.text: After breakfast, depart for Arusha National Park, a beautiful destination offering a combination of forests, lakes, mountains, and wildlife. Begin with a guided walking experience, allowing you to explore nature from a different perspective and observe smaller wildlife and birds. Enjoy excellent bird-watching opportunities and beautiful views of Mount Meru, Tanzania’s secondhighest mountain. Later, continue with a game drive through the park, looking for giraffes, zebras, buffalo, warthogs, antelopes, monkeys, and other wildlife. Return to Arusha for the evening.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
itinerary.text: After breakfast, drive to Tarangire National Park, famous for its magnificent baobab trees, large elephant herds, and diverse wildlife. Enjoy a game drive through the park while searching for elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffalo, and numerous bird species. The park’s dramatic landscapes provide excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography. Later, continue to your accommodation for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Tarangire to Serengeti – Big Cats & Carnivores
itinerary.text: After breakfast, begin your journey toward the legendary Serengeti National Park. As you enter the Serengeti, start your game drive with a focus on big cats and other carnivores. Search for lions, cheetahs, leopards, hyenas, jackals, and other predators while also enjoying encounters with wildebeest, zebras, giraffes, and other wildlife. Your professional guide will follow wildlife activity and share knowledge about animal behavior and the Serengeti ecosystem. Continue to your camp or lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Serengeti – Migration & Big Cats
itinerary.text: Spend a full day exploring the Serengeti, focusing on the Great Wildebeest Migration and big cats. Depending on the season and location of the herds, your guide will follow areas where large numbers of wildebeest and zebras are concentrated. Along the way, search for lions, cheetahs, and leopards, as well as other predators and herbivores. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. This flexible day allows you to spend more time observing wildlife and enjoying the Serengeti landscape.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Serengeti – Follow the Migration
itinerary.text: Today is dedicated entirely to following the Great Wildebeest Migration. After an early breakfast, head into the Serengeti with your guide to search for the movement of wildebeest and zebras. The exact location of the herds changes with the season, so your guide will use local knowledge and current wildlife conditions to determine the best areas to explore. Along the way, you may encounter predators following the herds, including lions, cheetahs, hyenas, and other carnivores. Enjoy another full day surrounded by the incredible scenery and wildlife of the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Serengeti Game Drive – Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.text: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast before embarking on a half-day game drive in the Serengeti. Make the most of your final hours in the park, searching for wildlife and enjoying the beautiful plains before beginning your journey toward the Ngorongoro Highlands. As you leave the Serengeti, the landscape gradually changes from open savannah to the lush highlands surrounding Ngorongoro. Arrive at your accommodation in the highlands, enjoy dinner, and relax in preparation for the following day’s crater experience.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater – Wildlife Experience
itinerary.text: After breakfast, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for a memorable game drive. The crater is home to a remarkable concentration of wildlife, offering opportunities to see lions, elephants, buffalo, zebras, wildebeest, hippos, and, with luck, the endangered black rhino. Enjoy a picnic lunch surrounded by the dramatic volcanic scenery before ascending from the crater and beginning your drive to Arusha. Arrive in the evening and relax.

itinerary.title: Coffee Tour, Materuni Waterfall & Kilimanjaro Airport
itinerary.text: After breakfast, begin your final Tanzanian experience with a local coffee tour. Learn how coffee is traditionally grown, harvested, processed, roasted, and prepared. Continue to Materuni Village, where you will enjoy a guided hike through lush landscapes to the beautiful Materuni Waterfall. Take time to enjoy the scenery, local environment, and, weather permitting, spectacular views of Mount Kilimanjaro. After completing your activities, drive to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your departure flight. We recommend booking a late-evening flight from 7:00 PM onward, allowing enough time to enjoy the coffee tour, waterfall hike, and Kilimanjaro views without rushing.
